decisive_items: Papillary fronds with slender fibrovascular cores that are lined by nonkeratinizing squamous epithelium
exophytic, verrucous, skin-colored plaque on the right nasal vestibule
response.rationale: The histologic examination reveals papillary fronds with nonkeratinizing squamous epithelium, which is consistent with squamous papilloma. The clinical presentation of an exophytic, verrucous, skin-colored plaque also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.why: Inverted papilloma is less likely due to the lack of characteristic features such as a prominent inverted growth pattern.
Verrucous carcinoma is less likely due to the lack of cytologic atypia or atypical mitotic figures.
